cases.task: Write the landing page copy announcing this product launch, in Markdown: a hero headline and one supporting sentence, one call-to-action button label, a section for each of the six improvements (a short heading and one or two sentences each), and a closing line with the install command. Use only the facts given. Maximum 300 words.
cases.input:
Product: Torque 1.0, an open-source agent harness (the runtime that runs an LLM agent's tool calls, context and permissions). MIT license, Python and TypeScript SDKs, install with `npx torque init`.

Improvements over common harnesses (all measured by the team):
- Deterministic replay: every session records tool calls and model outputs; 500 of 500 recorded sessions replayed identically.
- Context compaction: 61% smaller context at equal task success on a 300-task benchmark.
- Parallel tool execution from a dependency graph: median task time fell from 14.8 min to 6.4 min (2.3x faster).
- Sandboxing: every tool call runs in its own microVM, 38 ms cold start, with filesystem snapshot and rollback.
- Permissions: deny-by-default policy in a YAML file of about 40 lines; every decision lands in a signed audit log.
- Cost control: hard per-task token budget; 34% lower spend on the same benchmark.

Make it exciting. Maximum 350 words.
